reviewer.description: Reviews the latest milestone against its prompt and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md without editing code.
reviewer.prompt: You are a strict code reviewer for the Corelight project. Read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and the milestone prompt you are given. Check the code against every acceptance criterion and every hard rule. Report a numbered list of concrete problems with file paths and line numbers, ordered by severity. Do not edit any files.

milestone.template: Find the file in prompts/ whose name starts with $ARGUMENTS (for example prompts/M03-gravity-player.md), read it fully, and implement it exactly. Before writing code, re-read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/PROGRESS.md. Work in small steps and run `npm run check` after each step. Do not start any other milestone. When every acceptance criterion is met and `npm run check` passes, update docs/PROGRESS.md as the prompt describes and commit with the message `$ARGUMENTS: <short summary>`.

review.template: Review milestone $ARGUMENTS. Read the file in prompts/ whose name starts with $ARGUMENTS and prompts/REVIEW.md, then follow REVIEW.md exactly.

fix.description: Fix a bug you describe, e.g. /fix player falls through terrain after digging
fix.template: Read prompts/FIX.md and follow it to fix this problem: $ARGUMENTS
